images.title: A drawing class in 24-hour time
images.purpose: Show the time from 13:40 hours to 16:15 hours as three hops on a time line: 20 minutes to 14:00 hours, 2 hours to 16:00 hours and 15 minutes to 16:15 hours.
images.composition: A caption at the top, a time line with three curved hops above it, four labelled times under it in two rows, and the total written large at the bottom.
images.exact_structure: Plain white frame, 1456 by 816. TOP LEFT: the caption A drawing class starts at 13:40 hours and ends at 16:15 hours in dark #1F2937 sans-serif bold (36 px), left edge at x 100, about y 70. TIME LINE: one thin dark #2B2B2B horizontal line (5 px) at y 420 from x 130 to x 1308, with exactly 4 tall vertical ticks (44 px, y 398 to 442) at x 130, 282, 1194 and 1308, and no other ticks. HOPS: exactly 3 curved arrows above the line, each a smooth curved arc (the top of an ellipse) with its arrowhead at the right end pointing down onto the line (6 px). Hop 1 is teal #0072B2, from x 130 to x 282 (152 px wide) and 60 px high, with the label 20 minutes centred above it, about y 320 (36 px, bold, dark). Hop 2 is amber #E69F00, from x 282 to x 1194 (912 px wide) and 120 px high, with the label 2 hours centred above it, about y 255 (44 px, bold, dark). Hop 3 is reddish purple #CC79A7, from x 1194 to x 1308 (114 px wide) and 60 px high, with the label 15 minutes centred above it, about y 320 (36 px, bold, dark). The hops are in proportion to their time: the 20 minutes hop is 152 px, the 2 hours hop is 912 px and the 15 minutes hop is 114 px. TIME LABELS in two rows, dark bold (32 px), each centred under its tick: first row at about y 505: 13:40 hours (x 130) and 16:15 hours (x 1308); second row at about y 570: 14:00 hours (x 282) and 16:00 hours (x 1194), each joined to its tick by a thin grey #6B7280 vertical line (2 px) from y 442 to y 550. BOTTOM: centred at x 719 and about y 720, one line of bold dark text, 2 hours 35 minutes (72 px), the largest text in the frame. Nothing else in the frame.
labels: A drawing class starts at 13:40 hours and ends at 16:15 hours
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
more or fewer than 4 tick marks or 3 hop arrows
hops that are not in proportion to their time: the 20 minutes hop is 152 px, the 2 hours hop is 912 px and the 15 minutes hop is 114 px
images.takeaway: 13:40 hours to 14:00 hours is 20 minutes, then 2 hours to 16:00 hours, then 15 minutes to 16:15 hours, so the class lasts 2 hours 35 minutes.
images.description: A time line from 13:40 hours to 16:15 hours with hops of 20 minutes, 2 hours and 15 minutes, and 2 hours 35 minutes written below.
images.context: Concept image for Time Between in 24-Hour Time. It follows the idea of the solved example in your maths book (the time between two 24-hour times found by hopping to the next whole hour and then counting on) and shows the concept's own example of a drawing class.
images.teaching_notes: Let the child say the hops aloud: to the next whole hour, then whole hours, then the rest, and then add the minutes. The slip to watch: taking 40 from 15 in a column instead of hopping.

image_decisions.why: The time line with a hop to the next whole hour, a hop of whole hours and a hop for the rest shows the counting strategy for 24-hour times.
